meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 先问你在做什么工作，据此提出一套笔记分类（观察类型与概念标签），经你确认后写入 claude-mem 并激活，可选配置 Telegram 提醒，最后重启 worker 并验证启动上下文里出现该模式。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签、或为某类记忆发 Telegram 通知时触发，没提到「模式」二字也行。

say.text: 帮我建一个自定义模式，记录法律案例中的规则和考点
say.note: 它会先问你几个问题，再给出分类方案

say.text: 我要给这个模式加几个观察类型和概念标签
say.note: 通常各提 4 到 8 个，交你确认

say.text: 这个模式记录某几类笔记时给我发 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 需要先有机器人 token 和 chat ID

howto.what_en: Interviews you about your work, then proposes a note taxonomy of observation types and concept tags; after your approval it installs and activates a custom claude-mem mode, optionally configures Telegram alerts, restarts the worker and verifies the mode appears in startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or get Telegram alerts for particular memories—even without saying "mode."

say_en.text: Create a custom mode that records rules and exam traps from law cases.
say_en.note: It asks questions first, then proposes a taxonomy.

say_en.text: Add a few observation types and concept tags to this mode.
say_en.note: Usually 4-8 of each, for your approval.

say_en.text: Alert me on Telegram when this mode records certain note types.
say_en.note: Requires a bot token and chat ID.
